shape: Quest-start dead-end (single south gate + default spawn)
description: Tiny dead-end room used as the quest-start cell. Has one normal portal (spawn_south) plus a 'default' spawn point a few meters north of the gate — that's where the player materializes on first entry (no incoming portal to spawn from). The autopilot ultimately leaves through load_south. The interior is essentially a single straight stub between the two spawn points.

portals.south: spawn_south at (0.05, 11.64) — the only portal, on the south (high-Z) side

anchors.description: default spawn — player materializes here on quest start (matches wp_spawn_default)

traversalNotes: Quest-start cell: when entered via the 'default' spawn (first cell of a new quest), the autopilot's start position is quest_start and it walks to south_gate to exit. When re-entered later through the south portal, it just exits the same way.
DISPATCH RULE: any in-cell objective routes through quest_start (the room is short enough that quest_start acts as the only useful interior dispatch hub).
Same primitive as na1 (single-gate dead-end) but with an extra 'default' spawn marker. Solver should treat as a dead-end with a quest-start tag.
